description: This file defines an abstract class CommandControl used for creating UI command controls within the application, including button creation and event handling.

classes.name: CommandControl
classes.description: An abstract class providing a UI component with a label, optional components, and a test button that sends commands via CommandQueue.

methods.name: CommandControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components including label, icon, and button, and setting up the action listener.

methods.name: createButtonListener
methods.description: Creates an ActionListener that sends the command string to CommandQueue when button is pressed.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the specific command string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the UI component encapsulating this control, wrapped via UiUtils.wrap.
